notes: Bench-top cryogen-free probe station: 654 x 676 mm footprint with a 203 mm OD x 132 mm tall electroless-nickel aluminum vacuum chamber, 152 mm top opening, 63.5 mm fused-quartz top viewport (54 mm viewing), inner radiation shield (132 mm lid, 50 mm IR-absorbing window). Two-stage CCR: 1st stage cools the radiation shield (catalog cross-section labels 35 K), 2nd stage cools the sample stage (10 K base with 6 arms; 8 K with 2, 9 K with 4). Six micro-manipulated probe arms anchored to the shield with ZN50 probe bases braid-anchored to the sample stage (probes ~18 K / <20 K). Cooldown 3.5 h, warmup 2.25 h, 6.25 h cycle. Vibration at sample <2 um. The CCR is tagged cryogen_free_gm as the closest enum: Lake Shore does not name the cold head technology, so the GM displacer motion is not sourced and is listed in not_found rather than in moving_parts. Ring magnet kit (PS-RING-MAG-KIT) and PS-HTSTAGE are not fitted in this configuration.
